matches.title: Karlsruher SC vs Inter
matches.description: Watch Karlsruher SC vs Inter highlights and goals from Friendly on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on July 26, 2026. The pre-season friendly between Karlsruher SC and Inter on July 26, 2026 , delivered a masterclass in persistence and late-game drama. Both sides used the occasion to test their tactical depth in a match that remained unpredictable until the final whistle. Breaking the Deadlock After a tightly contested first half where chances were at a premium, the game roared to life shortly after the restart. In the 50th minute, T. Civeja found the breakthrough for Karlsruher SC , firing his side into a 1-0 lead. The goal shifted the momentum in favor of the hosts, who began to play with increased confidence, while Inter was forced to chase the game and search for a creative spark in the final third. As the second half progressed, the physical nature of the contest intensified. T. Civeja , the opening goalscorer, found himself in the referee's book in the 70th minute, receiving a yellow card as Karlsruher SC fought hard to preserve their advantage. It appeared for a long time that the German side would hold on for a narrow victory, as they successfully frustrated the Italian giants' attacking maneuvers. Diouf’s Stoppage-Time Brilliance Just as the match entered its final moments, the narrative took a stunning turn in favor of the visitors. In the first minute of stoppage time (90+1'), A. Diouf found the back of the net to equalize for Inter , silencing the home crowd. The late goal injected a sudden burst of energy into the Nerazzurri, who refused to settle for a draw. In a breathtaking conclusion to the match, A. Diouf struck again in the 90+4th minute, completing a sensational personal brace and securing a 1-2 victory for Inter . The dramatic turnaround left Karlsruher SC stunned, as they saw a potential win evaporate in the space of just three minutes. For Inter , it was a testament to their "never say die" attitude, turning a looming defeat into a morale-boosting triumph.
